## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (`python -m pytest`)
- [ ] `ruff check`, `ruff format --check` and `mypy` pass
- [ ] New or changed ATT&CK rules pass `ttprism validate-rules` and cite a reference
- [ ] Test data is synthetic or TLP:CLEAR, uses reserved names/addresses where possible, and contains no malware
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated for user-visible changes
